title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Underway
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, crucial for future national representation.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has organized a national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare junior players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course is vital for upgrading the skills of Indian badminton coaches, ensuring better training and development for players nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to enhance coaching expertise.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent to compete at the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, fostering regional success.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Player Eligibility and Qualified List for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This update provides clarity on the selection process for Indian junior players aiming to represent the country at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: BAI has released details regarding player eligibility and the list of players who have qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change directly impacts how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played, affecting player strategies and development.
summary: BAI has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
